blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables streaming generation by producing
video blocks conditioned on previously generated content. This formulation
supports interactive applications including world modeling, game simulation,
and embodied intelligence ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Ball et al., 2025 ) .
Despite these capabilities, repeatedly denoising each block increases
inference cost. Reducing the number of sampling steps while preserving visual
quality is therefore important for real-time video generation.

To reduce this cost, distillation methods ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) convert pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into few-step AR
students. The training pipeline typically consists of an initialization stage
followed by asymmetric distribution matching distillation
(DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Beyond accelerating sampling,
initialization must account for the difference between bidirectional teachers
and causal students. Prior analysis ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) identifies frame-level
injectivity as a requirement for recovering the teacher’s flow map through ODE
distillation: each input available to the student must determine a unique
endpoint. A bidirectional teacher can violate this requirement through its
dependence on future frames unavailable to the student. Training an intermediate
AR teacher and distilling its causal trajectories provides compatible targets,
but requires two training stages before DMD.

blocks.en:
However, resolving causal compatibility does not by itself ensure high-quality
few-step generation. In this work, we revisit the supervision used to construct
the initialization. Direct latent regression favors posterior-mean clean
predictions: when the noisy input and its conditions admit different plausible
continuations, coordinate-wise averaging can blur texture and blend incompatible
structures. This concerns individual clean predictions rather than the output
distribution of a complete multi-step sampler. Empirically, directly shortening
the sampling schedule of the teacher-forced AR diffusion model produces blurred
outputs. Causal ODE initialization alleviates this blur, but still leaves fine
detail unresolved under few-step sampling. Figure 2 compares
the initialization methods as the number of sampling steps decreases, revealing
a larger quality gap between ODE initialization and RepForcing at four steps.
Thus, deterministic teacher targets do not remove the observed limitation. These
findings motivate an alternative to intermediate-teacher initialization, rather
than an additional distillation stage.

blocks.en:
To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing (RepForcing), which learns few-step causal initialization directly in a
pretrained video representation space. The student predicts clean video blocks
under teacher forcing, and its predicted video is compared with the training
target through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer.
Unlike coordinate-wise latent regression, this objective need not favor the
latent posterior mean. RepForcing preserves the causal student architecture
and reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional Wan model from
VidProM ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) prompts for intermediate AR teacher training.
It requires no additional causal ODE trajectory pairs. A single teacher-forced
phase replaces both intermediate-teacher training and ODE distillation, after
which the student undergoes the same asymmetric DMD refinement using its own
generated prefixes.

Before DMD, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
AR video diffusion produces a video block by block and runs diffusion within
each block, which enables streaming
generation ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . During
training, each block is conditioned on clean history under teacher forcing or on
noisy history under diffusion forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , whereas at
inference it is conditioned on generated history. Self
Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) closes this gap by training on self-rollouts with
KV caching, AAPT ( Lin et al., 2026 ) uses adversarial post-training for
single-step streaming, and further work extends the generation
horizon ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) and Self Forcing initialize the AR student with
ODE pairs from a bidirectional teacher before DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) .
Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) replaces this teacher with an AR model
trained under teacher forcing, so that the distilled trajectories respect
causality. Causal Forcing++ ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) and
Causal-rCM ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) substitute causal consistency distillation
or training for the trajectory stage, building on consistency
models ( Song et al., 2023 ; Lu and Song, 2025 ) . All of these learn the few-step
initialization from an intermediate multi-step teacher; we instead obtain it
directly from the shared bidirectional-model-generated training videos by
changing the regression metric.

Perceptual losses compare predictions and targets through a pretrained
network ( Simonyan and Zisserman, 2014 ; Johnson et al., 2016 ) , and
LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) calibrates such distances to human
judgments. In generative modeling, REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and
Geometry Forcing ( Wu et al., 2026 ) align a generator’s internal activations
with an external encoder such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) ,
REPA-E ( Leng et al., 2025 ) extends this alignment to end-to-end VAE tuning,

for adversarial distillation. Our objective differs from each of them: it preserves
the generator architecture and VAE, requires no discriminator, and
uses a frozen video DiT only to measure the distance between a predicted
clean latent and its target.

Proposition 1 shows that latent regression favors the
conditional mean of clean continuations compatible with the noisy input and

schedule provides fewer refinement steps. The proposition characterizes direct
clean predictions, rather than the output distribution of the complete sampler.

under four-step sampling, indicating that diffusion training alone does not
provide the required few-step initialization in this setting.

The representation loss should favor detailed predictions rather than
latent blends. We use two criteria for the extractor Φ L , τ \Phi_{L,\tau} . First , we favor video representations that capture motion
and inter-frame relations, which frame-wise image features do not explicitly
model. This motivates extracting features from whole video sequences rather
than individual frames. Second , features
should be read from an intermediate depth. We expect shallow features to be close to an isometry of
the latent space and thus to inherit its averaging behaviour, and the deepest
features to become invariant to fine appearance.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we examine the limitations of intermediate-teacher initialization
for few-step autoregressive video generation. Our analysis links latent regression
to posterior-mean predictions, while experiments reveal that causal ODE
initialization still leaves fine detail unresolved under few-step sampling.
Motivated by these findings, we propose Representation Forcing, which supervises
the causal student’s clean predictions through normalized features of a frozen
video diffusion transformer. A single teacher-forced phase on the same synthetic
training videos replaces intermediate-teacher training and causal ODE distillation,
followed by asymmetric DMD. Experiments show that RepForcing better preserves
generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization at four
sampling steps before DMD. After DMD, it achieves higher VBench Total and
VisionReward than the reported Causal Forcing baselines in both chunk-wise and
frame-wise generation, without additional causal ODE trajectory generation.

blocks.en: 1. In spring on a coastal cliff carpeted with wildflowers, a fashion model in a white blouse and sea green skirt fills the foreground in cinematic 4K. She turns into the wind, then steps forward with confident posture as the camera glides close to fluttering fabric and natural skin. Behind, turquoise waves shimmer and seabirds arc through bright air. Crisp petal texture, clean highlights, and gentle film grain make the landscape feel fresh, elegant, and hauntingly beautiful. 2. High summer on a desert highway pull - off, a traveler in a white linen shirt and tan scarf fills the foreground in cinematic 4K. He wipes dust from sunglasses, lifts a bottle to drink, then walks toward a viewpoint as the camera tracks beside him through shimmering heat. Behind him, red mesas glow under harsh sun and a distant storm paints the sky violet. Dust motes, fabric fibers, and skin tones are crisp; gentle film grain grounds the vast, dramatic realism. 3. A cozy reading nook scene in a warm, inviting interior, featuring a playful llama sitting on a soft, plush rug. The llama is surrounded by an array of colorful, cozy pillows and soft blankets, creating a snug and comfortable atmosphere. Golden lighting from a floor lamp casts a warm glow throughout the space, enhancing the cozy ambiance. The llama reads a picture book aloud, using expressive voices to bring the characters to life. The camera captures the llama’s animated face and the charming illustrations within the book, with a close-up view of both the reader and the pages. 4. In late autumn in a candle lit chapel, a violinist in a black satin dress fills the foreground in cinematic 4K. She plays a slow phrase, then accelerates into a shimmering run as the camera moves close to bow hair and fingerwork. Outside stained glass, rain taps softly and leaves swirl in the courtyard. Warm flame light paints her face and instrument, with true tones and gentle film grain making the performance hauntingly beautiful. 5. On a winter sunrise above a frozen fjord, a mountaineer in an orange down suit and mirrored goggles dominates the frame in ultra clean UHD. He tightens his harness, then steps onto a ridge as wind lifts powder into glittering sheets. The camera holds close on breath mist and frost on his lashes, then reveals blue ice, dark water cuts, and distant peaks glowing pink. Every seam, strap, and snow crystal reads sharply, with subtle film grain grounding the grandeur. 6. A vibrant and lively vlog-style photo of a corgi in tropical Maui, showcasing the dog energetically filming itself on a sandy beach. The corgi stands on the shore, one paw slightly lifted, with a joyful and curious expression. It wears a colorful collar and a small backpack camera slung over its neck. The background features a lush, palm-fringed beach with clear turquoise waters and a bright blue sky. The photo has a warm, natural lighting effect, capturing the corgi from a slightly elevated angle, emphasizing its playful and adventurous spirit. 7. In spring on a lavender hillside after rain, a woman in a cream blouse and lilac skirt dominates the frame in cinematic 4K. She lifts a bouquet to her face, then walks forward as the camera tracks close to her smile and the shimmer of dew on blossoms. Behind her, clouds break and sunlight warms purple rows stretching to a distant chapel. Sharp textures, true tones, and gentle film grain make the landscape hauntingly beautiful. 8. A serene watercolor painting of a mother duck leading her six ducklings across a tranquil pond. The mother duck has a gentle expression, her feathers glistening in the sunlight, and she frequently glances back to ensure all her ducklings are safely following in a neat little line. The ducklings follow closely behind, their small heads bobbing up and down as they waddle along. The background features a peaceful pond with lily pads and ducks floating nearby, creating a harmonious and natural scene. A mid-shot from a slightly elevated angle captures the mother duck and her ducklings in motion.

blocks.zh: 详细而温暖的野生动物照片 捕捉母鸟 温柔地喂养她的雏鸟 在舒适的巢穴。 母鸟轻轻地将食物放入她鸣叫的雏鸟所开阔的喙中,雏鸟们急切地等待着他们的进食. 她的羽毛柔软而柔软,有温和而细心的表达. 雏鸟有小而圆的脑袋,有宽敞的喙和大而好奇的眼睛. 巢内有柔软的花草和花枝相接而成的花序,而背景则呈现出一片模糊的森林地貌,被凹陷的阳光过滤出叶子. 该相片具有自然的纪录片风格. 从略高的角度拍摄特写镜头,以母鸟与雏鸟的互动为主.

blocks.en: In spring on a hillside above a bright lake, a woman in a light yellow dress and straw hat dominates the frame in cinematic 4K. blocks.zh: 在明亮的湖面上的一个山坡上,一位穿着淡黄色裙子和草帽的女人在电影4K中主导了框架. 她选择了野花,然后将花向镜头抬起,因为相机滑翔更接近她快乐的表情. 在她身后 有水发光 有小船漂流 有山软化成蓝色雾霾 锋利的纹理,真实的音调,和温柔的电影谷物,创造了温暖而高涨的美.
